package.name: Mount Abu

research.recognisable_features: Rajasthan's only hill station: a small town on a granite plateau of the Aravalli range, built around Nakki Lake, with rounded boulder-strewn hills and green forest standing out against the dry plains below
research.dominant_landscape: Forested granite plateau and ridges of the southern Aravallis, about 1,200 m above sea level
research.key_landmark: Nakki Lake and the town around it, with Guru Shikhar (about 1,722 m, the Aravallis' highest point) rising behind
research.surroundings: Compact hill town of pitched and flat-roofed buildings, hotels and older villas on wooded slopes; dry plains visible far below the plateau edge
research.uncertainties: Exact building colours and how many boats are on the lake vary by day; kept generic. Dilwara temples are not in frame.

package.geographic_description: Hill station on a rocky plateau in the Aravalli range, Sirohi district, southern Rajasthan, centred on Nakki Lake.
package.primary_subject: Nakki Lake with the town of Mount Abu around its shore and forested granite hills behind
package.drone_viewpoint: Over the lake's southern side looking north-east, so the lake sits mid-frame with Guru Shikhar's ridge rising behind
package.lighting: Soft, low sun from the left lighting the town and hill slopes, long gentle shadows from the boulders and trees, calm reflections on the lake
package.weather: Clear post-monsoon evening with light mist settling in the valleys and a few scattered clouds
package.environmental_details: Green Aravalli dry-deciduous forest, rounded granite boulders and outcrops, a few small boats on the lake, a road looping the shore with light traffic
package.composition: Lake in the lower middle, town spreading along the left shore, forested ridge rising to the upper right, open evening sky across the top for text
package.visual_description: An early-evening aerial of Mount Abu: a small hill town around Nakki Lake, green forested granite hills rising behind, and soft mist settling in the valleys.
package.image_prompt: Aerial photograph of Mount Abu, Rajasthan's only hill station, in Sirohi district on a granite plateau of the Aravalli range. Nakki Lake lies at the centre of the frame, its calm water reflecting the evening sky, with a few small boats and a road looping the shore with light traffic. The compact town of pitched and flat-roofed buildings, hotels and older villas spreads along the left shore among trees. Behind it rise rounded, boulder-strewn hills covered in green Aravalli dry-deciduous forest, climbing to the Guru Shikhar ridge. Captured from a drone at 220 m altitude over the southern side of the lake, camera tilted 25° downward, 28mm full-frame perspective, looking north-east. Early evening, soft low sun from the left, long gentle shadows from boulders and trees, soft reflections on the lake. Clear post-monsoon air with light mist settling in the valleys and a few scattered clouds. Lake in the lower middle, ridge in the upper right, open sky band across the top for text. No snow, no crowds, no desert tones on the plateau.
package.alt_text: Aerial view of Mount Abu in Sirohi, Rajasthan, India
package.image_description: Early-evening aerial view of Mount Abu, with the hill town around Nakki Lake, forested granite hills of the Aravalli range rising behind, and light mist settling in the valleys.
package.website_caption: Mount Abu, Rajasthan's only hill station, sits on an Aravalli plateau around Nakki Lake.
